description: Any Actor can delete any comment: Priya's agent deleted Marcus's human comment with success, while edit and resolve are author-only. The comment vanished from Marcus's panel with no notice or undo.
expected: Delete is restricted to the author (or explicitly to human project members), matching edit/resolve, and the author is told when a comment is removed.
actual: comment-delete by a non-author agent succeeded.
suggested_fix: Add the author check to comment delete (prepareCommentDelete) and a regression test; consider a tombstone line ('Comment deleted by …') in the panel.

description: Every person's built-in agent is named 'Setup agent', so two different people's agents look identical in Activity, comments and the avatar stack (two 'SA' chips). The non-author delete reads 'Setup agent deleted a comment', indistinguishable from Marcus's own agent.
expected: Agent names carry the owner, e.g. 'Priya's Setup agent' or 'Setup agent (Priya Raman)'.
suggested_fix: Include the sponsoring human's name in agent display names wherever an Actor is rendered.

criterion: One way per task / Dead ends
description: A human cannot edit or delete their own comment: the browser has no affordance, and `client operation` runs as the person's 'Setup agent', which the author check refuses. CLI writes made that way appear under 'Setup agent' and show as New to the person who made them.
expected: Edit/Delete on your own comments in the browser.
actual: No route for a human author. Standalone `show`/`comment` with `--data` give LOCAL_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE / ACTOR_REQUIRED.
suggested_fix: Add Edit/Delete to the comment header for the author; have the CLI errors point to `client operation` or `--token-file`.
